decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to bounce back multiple mana artifacts and draw cards, generating a significant amount of mana and card advantage. The deck includes various fast mana sources like Black Lotus, Moxen, and Sol Ring to power out powerful spells such as Ancestral Recall and Time Walk. The goal is to set up a board state where you can easily combo off with cards like Time Vault and Tolarian Academy, while also having plenty of protection with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The overall strategy revolves around generating a massive amount of resources and overwhelming the opponent with a quick and efficient win condition.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays using Azorius colored spells and creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to generate card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and control the game with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will. The deck also utilizes powerful mana acceleration cards like Moxes and Sol Ring to cast powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk early in the game. The overall strategy is to establish board presence and maintain control to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to establish control through a combination of powerful spells and disruptive creatures, backed up by efficient removal and counter magic. By leveraging key cards such as Force of Will, Fatal Push, and Lórien Revealed, as well as powerful draw and tutor effects like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in order to secure victory. The inclusion of powerful mana sources like Mox Sapphire and Black Lotus allows for explosive plays and the ability to quickly stabilize board presence.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan by utilizing multiple taxing effects, such as Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst. It also aims to control the board with powerful creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. The deck relies on Mishra's Workshop to generate extra mana to cast its threats and lock down the opponent's plays. It also has a strong artifact synergy with cards like Nettlecyst and Mystic Forge. Ultimately, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents while aggressively pushing damage through the use of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Collector Ouphe, it aims to control the board and establish a dominant position. With a mix of removal, countermagic, and card advantage, it aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a combination of pressure and disruption. The deck excels at adapting to a variety of matchups and leveraging its powerful synergy between creatures and spells to overpower opponents in the midrange game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while putting pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex, it aims to slow down the opponent's spells and mana development. The deck also includes disruptive lands like Strip Mine and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's resources. By combining these hate cards with aggressive creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer, the deck aims to control the game and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with powerful artifact creatures and mana acceleration spells. By utilizing cards like Mana Crypt, Moxen, and Grim Monolith, the deck aims to play its threats quickly and efficiently. The key strategy revolves around generating large amounts of colorless mana to cast powerful creatures such as Lodestone Golem and Glaring Fleshraker, and to active abilities on cards like The One Ring and Nettlecyst. With efficient mana ramp and threatening creatures, this deck aims to put constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Paradoxical Outcome card to generate significant advantages by returning a large number of artifacts to hand while drawing cards. It includes key combo pieces like Time Vault and Mana Vault to generate infinite turns or mana, along with powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor for additional control and consistency. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's strategy with countermagic and removal spells, ultimately overwhelming them with card advantage and powerful combos.

This deck focuses on using powerful control elements such as counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes the Gifts Ungiven card to search for key combo pieces while filling the graveyard for value. The deck aims to generate card advantage and quickly assemble powerful win conditions, such as utilizing the Underworld Breach combo or casting powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk. It also includes cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Lotus Petal to provide additional value and flexibility in tight situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card draw to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck quickly. The goal is to assemble the Time Vault + Voltaic Key combo to take multiple turns in a row and secure the win. The deck also has disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to recur important cards from your graveyard.

This deck focuses on utilizing alternative win conditions such as Phyrexian Dreadnought and Doorkeeper Thrull, while also leveraging powerful card draw and control elements like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds consistency and resilience to the overall strategy, allowing for continuous access to key combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt opposing strategies using efficient counterspells and removal spells, ultimately overwhelming the opponent and securing a victory.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure with aggressive creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards like Archon of Emeria and Chalice of the Void. The strategy is to quickly establish board presence and restrict the opponent's options, ultimately overwhelming them with efficient threats. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen allows for explosive starts, while cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine provide additional disruption. The deck aims to control the game tempo and dictate the flow of play to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counter spells and removal, while using card advantage and utility lands to outvalue the opponent. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, protect your own threats, and slowly grind out a victory. By utilizing powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor, along with efficient creatures like Psychic Frog and Snapcaster Mage, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and maintain control of the game until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively use the Bazaar of Baghdad to discard cards and quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Squee, Goblin Nabob, and Vengevine. This allows for fast and explosive plays with cards like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Force of Will, Force of Vigor, and Force of Negation to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Noxious Revival allows for recursion of key cards, leading to a relentless and efficient aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to win the game with Doomsday, set up through various card draw, tutors, and disruption spells. Thassa's Oracle is a key win condition, while cards like Demonic Consultation and Necropotence help dig for crucial pieces. The deck also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to counter opposing strategies. Overall, the goal is to efficiently manipulate the top of the deck with Doomsday and win the game in a single turn.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures to set up explosive plays using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. By utilizing dredge mechanics and powerful creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Force of Will to protect its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam provide additional value and reach, creating a potent and fast-paced combo strategy.
